messages.content: 你能計算從地球到一個新發現的距離為4.22光年的外行星，再到另一個距離第一顆外行星6.1光年的外行星，最後再回到距離第二顆外行星5.88光年的地球所需的時間嗎？假設真空中光的速度為299792458公尺/秒。

function.name: light_travel_time
function.description: Calculate the time taken for light to travel from a celestial body to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance_in_light_years.description: The distance between the two celestial bodies in light years. This is a float type value.

speed_of_light.description: The speed of light in vacuum, in m/s. Default value is 299792458 m/s.

message.reasoning: We need to compute travel time for light from Earth to first exoplanet (4.22 ly), then to second exoplanet (distance between first and second is 6.1 ly), then back to Earth from second exoplanet (distance 5.88 ly). Sum times. Use function light_travel_time. We'll call it three times with distances 4.22, 6.1, 5.88. Then sum. Provide answer in seconds, maybe also convert to years. Let's compute: 1 light year = distance light travels in one year. So time in seconds = distance_in_light_years * (seconds per year). Seconds per year ~ 31557600 (Julian year). But we can compute using speed of light: distance in light years * (light year in meters) / speed of light. Light year in meters = speed_of_light * seconds_per_year. So time = distance_in_light_years * seconds_per_year. So simply distance_in_light_years * 31557600 seconds. So 4.22*31557600 =? 31557600*4 =126230400; 0.22*31557600=6942672; sum=133073072 seconds. Next 6.1*31557600=31557600*6=189345600; 0.1*31557600=3155760; sum=192401360. Next 5.88*31557600=31557600*5=157788000; 0.88*31557600=277,? 0.8*31557600=25246080; 0.08*31557600=2524608; sum=27770688; add to 157788000 gives 185558688. Sum all: 133073072+192401360=325474432; +185558688=511033120 seconds. Convert to years: divide by 31557600 ≈ 16.2 years. Let's compute precisely: 511033120 / 31557600 = 16.2? 31557600*16=504921600; remainder 511033120-504921600=6111520; /31557600=0.1937; so 16.1937 years. So about 16.19 years. Provide answer. Use function calls.
